scope: Eight visually inspected known pages from eight cached reports; rankings are evaluated within each report. This is a small acquisition regression set, not global relevance ground truth.

a tree farming process diagram with circular forest photographs and arrows

a financial table of regional bank results with five numeric columns, footnotes, and a ruled bold heading
two stacked color photographs of a pulp mill, railroad tank cars and factory buildings
three narrow columns of sans serif text with bold headings and a black and white drawing of a retail store
a large central color photograph of an airplane being assembled in a factory, flanked by text columns and small portraits
